thread:
Maria Chen: Quick sprint mid-point status. TL;DR: kernel PRs 2/3 merged, continuous-batching e2e failing, KV cache warmup improvements on track but we need cluster perf runs. Milestones and owners below, please ack.

Kevin Patel: Working on the kernel matmul vectorization fix. PR #4123 is in review — @Danielle Rios can you eyeball correctness? ETA: EOD tomorrow for perf numbers.

Danielle Rios: I picked up the continuous-batching e2e. Failing on a sequence-padding edgecase. Repro steps below.

```bash
pytest tests/e2e/test_continuous_batch.py -k padding -q
# fails on assert at tests/e2e/test_continuous_batch.py:87
```

Sam O'Neill: I can take the padding fix if Danielle wants a hand. Also we'll need a perf job scaled to 8 workers to validate throughput. @ops-bot can you schedule one?

ops-bot: Deployed perf job 2026-03-17-01 with 8 workers. Link: https://perf.internal/runs/2712345678-01 :robot_face:

Jordan Li: KV tuning update: local sim with eviction_threshold=0.35 (was 0.2) cut miss rate ~18% -> 11%. Planning cluster canary tomorrow AM. Need gating owner + rollback criteria. @Kevin Patel can you own gating? @Maria Chen please review rollout playbook.

Kevin Patel: I can own the gating. Suggested alerting: `kv_miss_rate > 0.05` sustained for 5m -> page, and auto-rollback if `p50_latency` increases by >5% over baseline for 10m.

Maria Chen: Added gating + rollback steps to the rollout doc. Note dependency: eng-platform needs to push the kernel micro-op upgrade before we merge #4123. @Sam O'Neill please post a short dependency note to #eng-platform.

Sam O'Neill: Will post now. Quick ops ask: can we freeze non-critical merges during the big perf run window? Propose: no merges 9:00-12:00 PST Wed.

Danielle Rios: :thumbsup: Agreed. I'll hold non-blocking test merges and queue them for after the window.

Maria Chen: Short checklist for visibility:
- Kevin: finish/merge kernel PR (#4123) by EOD Fri
- Danielle + Sam: fix padding edgecase and validate with perf job; canary Wed
- Jordan: KV eviction canary Thu, with gating owned by Kevin
- ops-bot: perf job link posted; run results to be attached to the rollout doc

Maria Chen: If anyone hits blockers, drop a quick note here and ping me. Thanks all :eyes:
